elements.description:
What a document is made of: the share from sources, AI synthesis and original writing, per section and in total,
with each segment opening its lineage.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the region's name

properties.name: scope
properties.description: What the summary covers, a quiet line under the heading – e.g. the document's name

properties.name: sections
properties.description: The document's sections, in order, with how much of each came from where

properties.name: unit
properties.description: The unit of the amounts, plural – "words", "characters", "sentences"

properties.name: totalLabel
properties.description: The name of the whole-document row

properties.name: totalOnly
properties.description: Hide the per-section rows and show the total only

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-lineage-open
events.description: A segment was pressed (detail: { section: string | null, kind: "sourced" | "synthesis" | "original", amount: number, share: number }) – section is null for the whole document

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the region's name

props.name: onOpenLineage
props.type: (section: string | null, kind: ProvenanceKind, detail: ProvenanceLineageOpen) => void
props.description: A segment was pressed: the section's id (null for the whole document), the kind, its amount and share

changelog: **Trust & calibration**, from THEMIS and built domain-neutral: - claims and their reliability: `tc-claim-answer`, `tc-verification-queue`, `tc-reflection-gate`, `tc-reliance-gauge`, `tc-disagreement-banner`, `tc-synthesis-notes`; - where outputs came from: `tc-lineage-graph`, `tc-validity-badge`, `tc-provenance-summary`, `tc-correction-propagation`, `tc-attestation-check`, `tc-run-manifest`; - policy and control: `tc-policy-simulator`, `tc-gate-config`, `tc-coverage-matrix`, `tc-kill-switch`, `tc-playbook-canvas`.
